title: Open upvalue and closure object graph
author: Robert Nystrom
license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for PNG illustrations; explicit repository LICENSE
reading_path: Stack function points to closure; closure branches to function metadata and upvalue array; upvalue points back to stack slot a.
merit: Field-level reference circles, irregular hand-drawn records and a long returning pointer explain aliasing while retaining the physical order of fields. The compact branch/back-reference composition challenges automatic routing.
reference_preview_method: Original raster flattened onto white with aspect and complete content unchanged.
